comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implement local report artifact storage for the local control-plane MVP. Feedback alignment computation already runs against local GraphQL and local seeded feedback data, but report block output/log persistence still assumes hosted S3 and leaves ReportBlock output as a placeholder when the bucket is unavailable. This slice should add MinIO-backed local artifact storage, preserve the compacted ReportBlock.output plus attachedFiles contract, and prove dashboard/report readback without hosted storage.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implemented local report artifact storage for the local control-plane MVP. Added MinIO to the smoke compose stack with an idempotent report-block bucket initializer, wired local dev/proof scripts to export object-store envs, updated Python report S3 utilities to use S3-compatible endpoint/path-style settings, and added a local-only dashboard storage route plus Amplify storage shim read/write support. Added scripts/smoke-local-report.sh to run the Nira feedback alignment report, verify compacted ReportBlock output plus attachedFiles, download the MinIO artifact, and assert total_items=200, accuracy=80.0, and overall_ac1=0.6000000000000001. Verification passed: s3_utils unit tests, dashboard local shim Jest test, report smoke, browser smoke for core pages, targeted report detail render with no hosted AWS requests, and local-mode dashboard build.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text:
Storage scope clarification:

MinIO is the local replacement for ordinary S3 object storage: report block output/log artifacts, downloadable attachments, uploaded datasets, task/item/score-result artifacts, and dashboard Amplify Storage calls.

MinIO does not replace AWS S3 Vectors. Vector indexing/search should be tracked separately as a local vector memory store task, likely using Chroma for the MVP.

Immediate storage focus:
- Prove report artifact storage is stable through MinIO.
- Audit every remaining ordinary S3/Amplify Storage path.
- Add smoke coverage for at least one artifact-bearing record outside ReportBlock.
- Keep hosted AWS storage unreachable in local MVP proof runs.

- Vector indexing/search is intentionally out of scope for this issue and is tracked under plx-83e08d.
